terms.comment: Lewis & Short: “of things, to sink, settle, subside”: of valleys, of floodwater going down, of spices settling at the bottom of a pot. So of a cake that falls in the middle. Of something that falls down altogether, see “collapse”.

phrases.english: Oh dear, the cake has sunk in the middle!

phrases.latin: Nōlī furnum aperīre, nē placenta subsīdat.
phrases.english: Don’t open the oven, or the cake will sink.
the rivers sink back, and the hills seem to rise out of the water

phrases.latin: quod sī nōn ita, ut praecēpimus, permiscueris, subsīdent arōmata et adūrentur
phrases.english: but if you don’t stir it as we have told you, the spices will sink to the bottom and burn
